items.title: Pay for professional cleaning (kitchen and bathroom)
items.quote: Please pay this amount within 14 days of receiving this letter.
items.computation: The period is 14 days starting from the day the letter is received (Zugang), not from a printed document date — the letter carries no date at all. No receipt date was given either, so under §§ 187, 188 BGB the day after receipt starts the count and the 14th day thereafter (shifted to the next business day in NW if it falls on a weekend or holiday) would be due, but without a document date or a stated/known receipt date the start of the period cannot be fixed. The due date is therefore left undetermined; once the actual receipt date is known, add 14 days (day of receipt not counted, §187 Abs.1 BGB) and shift to the next working day if needed.

warnings: The letter itself carries no printed date (no “Datum” field), and the actual day it was received is not stated, so the 14-day payment deadline cannot be computed exactly — confirm the date you actually received this letter and count 14 days from the day after that.
This is a demand from the landlord (a private company), not from a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the countdown starts on actual receipt.

The IBAN (DE95 3705 0198 0005 5505 00) is well-formed and matches a German bank, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to Beispielkey Lettings GmbH — verify it against a previous tenancy document or the company's official contact before paying, especially since this introduces a new payment obligation deducted-from/affecting your deposit.
